room.churchyard.title: Churchyard
room.churchyard.description: Leaning stones crowd the grass. A small [bell](bell) hangs in the lych gate, and an iron [gate](gate) bars the crypt steps.
detail.bell: A little bronze bell. By custom it is rung only between dusk and dawn.
detail.gate: An iron gate, its lock furred with rust.
detail.gate.open: The iron gate hangs open on the crypt steps.
narration.ring_bell.actor: You ring the lych bell. Its thin note carries over the graves.
narration.pick_lock.success: The lock gives with a gritty click. The gate swings open.
narration.pick_lock.failure: The pick slips in the rusted lock. It holds.
